# 1. Organise and clean the data

## 1.1 Subset the data into the specific dataset allocated
  

```{r}
# Only change the value for SID 
# Assign your student id into the variable SID, for example:
SID <- 2523424                 # This is an example, replace 2101234 with your actual ID
SIDoffset <- (SID %% 50) + 1    # Your SID mod 50 + 1

load("carbon-footprint.Rda")
# Now subset the survey data set
# Pick every 50th observation starting from your offset
# Put into your data frame named mydf (you can rename it)
mydf <- df[seq(from=SIDoffset,to=nrow(df),by=50),]


head(mydf)
str(mydf)
summary(mydf)
any(duplicated(mydf))

```

## 1.3 Data quality analysis findings

```{r}
# Logical consistency checks
sum(mydf$number_adults == 0)
mydf[mydf$number_adults == 0, ]

```
total 20 entrys of 0 number_adults

```{r}
# Range checks according to metadata 
mydf[mydf$annual_energy_consumption < 1000, ]
mydf[mydf$annual_energy_consumption > 9000, ]
summary(mydf$annual_energy_consumption)

```
4 values are out of range according to metadata 

```{r}
# Missing values in dataset  
colSums(is.na(mydf))

```
income have 22 missing values 

```{r}
# Categorical consistency
table(mydf$diet_type)
table(mydf$home_type)

```
home_type have spelling mistakes.

 
## 1.4 Data cleaning  
 
```{r}
# Verify Issue 1 removed
sum(mydf_clean$number_adults == 0)

# Verify Issue 2 removed
min(mydf_clean$annual_energy_consumption, na.rm = TRUE)

# Verify Issue 3 fixed
table(mydf_clean$home_type)
```

# 2. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

```{r}
summary(mydf_clean$carbon_footprint)
summary(mydf_clean$annual_energy_consumption)
summary(mydf_clean$number_adults)

```


###Element 1: 
```{r}
hist(mydf_clean$carbon_footprint,
     main = "Distribution of Carbon Footprint",
     xlab = "Carbon Footprint")
```

```{r}
boxplot(mydf_clean$carbon_footprint)

```

###Element 2:
```{r}
plot(mydf_clean$annual_energy_consumption,
     mydf_clean$carbon_footprint,
     xlab = "Annual Energy Consumption",
     ylab = "Carbon Footprint")

```

```{r}
cor(mydf_clean$annual_energy_consumption,
    mydf_clean$carbon_footprint,
    use = "complete.obs")

```

###Element 3:

```{r}
boxplot(carbon_footprint ~ home_type,
        data = mydf_clean,
        xlab = "Home Type",
        ylab = "Carbon Footprint")

```

```{r}
aggregate(carbon_footprint ~ home_type,
          data = mydf_clean,
          summary)

```

```{r}
mosaicplot(table(mydf_clean$home_type,
                 mydf_clean$recycles_regularly),
           xlab = "Home Type",
           ylab = "Recycles Regularly",
           main = "Recycling behaviour by home type",
           col = c("lightgrey", "lightblue"))

```



# 3. Modelling

# Starting model
```{r}
model_full <- lm(carbon_footprint ~ annual_energy_consumption +
                                   number_adults +
                                   home_type,
                 data = mydf_clean)

summary(model_full)

```

# Reduced model
```{r}
model_reduced <- lm(carbon_footprint ~ annual_energy_consumption +
                                      home_type,
                    data = mydf_clean)

summary(model_reduced)

```

# Diagnostics
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_reduced)

```

#Final model object
```{r}
model_final <- model_reduced

```


# 4. Modelling another dependent variable

# Target variable checks
```{r}
table(mydf_clean$recycles_regularly)

```
# Data type enforcement
```{r}
mydf_clean$home_type <- as.factor(mydf_clean$home_type)
mydf_clean$diet_type <- as.factor(mydf_clean$diet_type)

```

#Extra model interpretation support
```{r}
# Odds ratios with confidence intervals
exp(cbind(OR = coef(recycle_model), confint(recycle_model)))

```

# Model performance checks
```{r}
p_hat <- predict(recycle_model, type = "response")
pred_class <- ifelse(p_hat >= 0.5, 1, 0)

table(Predicted = pred_class,
      Actual = mydf_clean$recycles_regularly)

mean(pred_class == mydf_clean$recycles_regularly)

```
